articles.title: Philadelphia's Academy of Natural Sciences Museum Closes, Prompting Efforts to Reopen
articles.summary: The Academy of Natural Sciences Museum closed on September 30 after nearly two centuries of public visits. Supporters seek reopening while Drexel explores a funding offer and the city plans hearings.

articles.title: Trump Urges Calls to Cotton in Push for Permanent Daylight Saving Time
articles.summary: Trump urged Americans to contact Senator Tom Cotton in support of permanent daylight saving time. Cotton remains opposed as lawmakers debate evening daylight and darker winter school mornings.

articles.title: Ohio Truck Factory Layoffs Highlight a Region's Uneven Economic Change
articles.summary: Nearly 1,400 Springfield factory workers lost their jobs on September 30, three days before a nearby presidential rally. Aerospace businesses have brought investment as the region faces a long decline in factory jobs.
